_**User**_

Deploy attempt: local build on Windows
Toolchain status: Hugo Extended 0.163.3 (cached), Node v24.0.1, Go 1.24.3, Python 3.12.10 — all available. pnpm was not on PATH; enabled via corepack prepare pnpm@11.7.0 + corepack pnpm. Hugo was placed on PATH manually (not installed via mise).

Code changes made (not committed):

scripts/okf_bundle.py:65 — Added encoding="utf-8" to subprocess.run() capturing git log output. Without it, Windows decodes git's UTF-8 commit messages with cp1252, causing UnicodeDecodeError: 'charmap' codec can't decode byte 0x9d.
scripts/export-okf-bundle.py:287 — Added encoding="utf-8" to subprocess.run() capturing generate.py output. Same root cause — text=True defaults to locale encoding on Windows.
Errors encountered
Error 1: Python UnicodeEncodeError on Windows console
UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode character '\u2192' in position 50: character maps to <undefined>
File: scripts/okf-viz/generate.py line 277
Cause: Python on Windows uses cp1252 stdout encoding by default. generate.py prints → via print().
Workaround used: Set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 in the shell environment.
Error 2: nodeLinker: "isolated" despite .npmrc saying node-linker=hoisted
ERROR js.Build failed: Could not resolve "@pixi/colord/plugins/names"
ERROR js.Build failed: Could not resolve "@xmldom/xmldom"
ERROR js.Build failed: Could not resolve "eventemitter3"
ERROR js.Build failed: Could not resolve "parse-svg-path"
ERROR js.Build failed: Could not resolve "tiny-lru"
ERROR js.Build failed: Could not resolve "ismobilejs"
ERROR js.Build failed: Could not resolve "earcut"
Cause: node_modules/.modules.yaml has "nodeLinker": "isolated" (pnpm's default), but .npmrc specifies node-linker=hoisted. The .npmrc setting is not being respected by pnpm 11.7.0. A clean reinstall (rm -rf node_modules && pnpm install) still produces the isolated layout. PixiJS's transitive dependencies exist only in .pnpm/ and are not hoisted to top-level node_modules, so Hugo's esbuild cannot resolve them through symlinks on Windows.
Not fixed locally. Requires either pnpm config fix on Linux or manual hoisting.
Error 3: Tailwind tailwindcss.cmd not overwritten by fix-tailwind-bin.js
TAILWINDCCS: failed to transform "/css/main.css" (text/css): binary "tailwindcss" is not a Node.js script
Cause: pnpm generates tailwindcss.CMD (900 bytes) and tailwindcss.ps1 (1737 bytes) wrappers in node_modules/.bin/. The fix-tailwind-bin.js postinstall successfully overwrites tailwindcss (no extension, 78 bytes) and tailwindcss-shim.mjs (454 bytes), but does not overwrite tailwindcss.cmd/.ps1. The writeExecutable() function silently fails to replace these pnpm-generated wrappers — isFixed() returns false (correctly detecting the unshimmed .cmd), applyFix() runs, but the .cmd file retains pnpm's 900-byte wrapper content. The shimMjsPath, binPath, and winPs1Path entries are all unaffected by the failed write.
Not fixed locally. The isFixed() check and writeExecutable() need investigation.
Error 4: tailwindcss.cmd resolves to .pnpm store path
The pnpm-generated tailwindcss.CMD sets NODE_PATH pointing to:

node_modules/.pnpm/@tailwindcss+cli@4.3.1/node_modules/@tailwindcss/cli/node_modules
With the isolated layout, this path may not be accessible to Hugo's hexec subprocess executor on Windows.

These issues are Windows/pnpm-specific. The repo is configured for Cloudflare Pages CI which likely provides the correct environment. On Linux, the symlink resolution and encoding issues should not occur. I have not committed any changes.
